name: Slate Hill Cattle Company
old_description: At Slate Hill Cattle Company, we are committed to ethical cattle farming and sustainable ranching practices while raising premium Pinzgauer beef. Our Pinzgauer cattle are known for their resilience, adaptability, and superior beef quality, which is enhanced by our focus on humane treatment and environmentally responsible methods.
about:
Slate Hill Cattle Company operates from Portsmouth, Rhode Island, on Aquidneck Island. The ranch was founded by Dennis Welch, a U.S. Navy veteran who moved to the state in 2006 for engineering work at Naval Station Newport. After marrying Crystle, a native of the island, the couple built a family-run operation rooted in the cattle-raising traditions Welch learned on Oklahoma ranches in the Ozark foothills.

The company raises Pinzgauer cattle on a grass-fed, rotational-grazing system that emphasizes soil health and biodiversity. Beyond premium beef, the ranch practices zero-waste utilization: suet is rendered into tallow for cooking, skincare, and candle making, while organs are freeze-dried into custom dog treats. The herd is managed with a blend of traditional husbandry and modern technology to monitor herd health and resource efficiency.

Products are marketed directly to consumers seeking ethically raised beef and natural pet treats, with an emphasis on local and regional customers who value transparent, sustainable sourcing.

Welch frames the venture as a family affair dedicated to preserving the Pinzgauer breed and ranching heritage for future generations. The operation’s stated goals include reducing its carbon footprint, expanding educational outreach on sustainable farming, and advancing regenerative practices to serve as long-term stewards of the land.
